mentions.name: Peace
mentions.description: An automation framework for infrastructure-as-code that makes clear what will happen before, during, and after you run it.
mentions.problem: Infrastructure-as-code changes are opaque; it isn't clear what they will do before/during/after execution.
mentions.source_excerpt: - Side: https://peace.mk/ - Create my own automation framework, because I want to make it clear what infrastructure-as-code is going to do before/during/after you run it
